profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Typescript, Java/Spring, Golang, Python | Cloud & DevOps (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform) | 10+ Years Building Scalable Systems
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer passionate about building high-throughput, scalable web applications and distributed services. Skilled in Go, Java, CI/CD, Automated Testing, Web Applications, Agile Methodologies, and Cloud Tech. Strong engineering professional graduated from Hardcore Go.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Identity and Access Management (IAM)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Amplify team
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an Azure Databricks ETL pipeline to ingest and transform customer-sampled data with Spark, then load it into Azure Cosmos DB (MongoDB API), enabling scalable, low-latency access for downstream applications.
• Designed and implemented the Persona Data Service, decoupling persona logic from the GraphQL layer, and established Adobe-standard monitoring and alerting, improving system scalability and reliability.
• Led the Persona Thumbnail Image Optimization initiative, building a CDN-backed pipeline to replace default or missing images, significantly enhancing load times and visual quality.
• Architected and delivered the Cohort Field Insights feature, building major infrastructure stacks including pre-caching pipelines, database caching layers, and offline data processing — dramatically reducing latency and enabling near-instant UI load times. Collaborated across teams to debug performance bottlenecks and ensure a seamless user experience.
• Developed segment insights dashboards aligned with RTCDP data, ensuring robust integrations to support marketing analytics use cases.
• Played a key role in preparing the platform’s alpha launch for Amplify / Persona Service by proactively identifying and executing critical infrastructure improvements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - UCP team
positions.description:
• Spearheaded delivery of the Frequency Rules project, meeting all requirements and deadlines, ensuring critical success.
• Engineered and delivered a robust solution linking playbook publishing (marketing templates) to automated use case execution via Use Case Builder, AEP, and Marketing Experience (AJO) systems — foundational for current marketing workflows.
• Architected and executed a system consolidation plan, merging Marketing Experience and UCB platforms by deprecating legacy MariaDB paths in favor of CosmosDB, creating a unified, streamlined ecosystem.
• Enhanced Exim tooling and automation scripts to automate all Bounteous playbooks aligned to sandbox journeys, driving substantial efficiency gains and cutting processing times from weeks to hours.
• Led performance optimization initiatives across MEXP UI, GQL layer, and UCB, improving playbook detail page response times from 9 seconds to under 1 second, vastly enhancing user experience.
• Delivered the Data Awareness feature for UCP under tight deadlines, working across the full stack — from MEXP UI and XQL monolith to UCB and Exim backend — ensuring accurate AI-powered data mapping with AEP schemas.
• Developed and implemented a comprehensive integration test suite for UCP, validating end-to-end flows from initiative creation through AEP/AJO object generation to Exim package export and schema mapping, significantly reducing regression risks.
• Played a pivotal role in onboarding beta customers to UCP, identifying key gaps in presets/channel surfaces setup, and influencing improvements to product documentation.
• Optimized infrastructure by migrating UCB workloads from Moonbeam/CaaS to Flex instances, upgrading Jenkins (Sky Kraken) to stabilize CI/CD pipelines, and enhancing observability through NewRelic and PagerDuty integration.
• Recognized by leadership for adaptability and multi-codebase expertise, consistently taking ownership of complex, high-impact features and improving team velocity.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - SkyKraken team
positions.description:
• Drove the engineering decision making process for selecting the appropriate public cloud database provider (AWS DynamoDB vs. Azure CosmosDB). Considered tradeoffs in the cloud solutions and infrastructure analysis while simultaneously weighing supportability, team preferences and strategic alignment
• Drove the design and implementation for the cloud database services required for Digital Experience Core Services
• Worked within the team and outside the team to influence, collaborate on the best design and solution for Admin Tool last login performance issue, which is caused by slow log search as more data accumulates. Delivered the last login caching solution that greatly improves Admin Tool UI performance, satisfies customers, and removes on-call alerts for Admin Tool page load
• Contributed to the architecture, system design and implementation of the new Performance Metrics (a.k.a. Goals) as well as Use Cases Builder (a full stack solution that helps customers run automated customized workflows in Adobe Journey Optimizer and Adobe Experience Platform)
• Created UI integration tests for Use Case Builder. Set up these tests to run both on PR merged event (by SPA pipeline) and on a daily basis (on team's Jenkins server) that integrate Slack notifications
• Contributed to Message Simplification work, an effort to simplify the slightly complicated user experience in Adobe Journey Optimizer
• Delivered Landing Pages (part of Admin UI) and Frequency Rules SPA using Trident, a schema-based framework that can be used to create consistent form and inventory-based Single Page Applications

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a “Keep me signed in” experience that reduces user friction from signing in without reducing security
using OAuth 2.0 refresh token that was projected to increase net sales by $44M annually
• Led the delivery of modernized password reset feature that increased annual demand by $11.4M and cut the number of calls to Customer Care by half
• Led a delivery of canary deployment with an automated CI/CD pipeline that greatly reduced the number of deployment incidents
• Moved two different services from AWS EC2 based stacks to a company-shared Kubernetes cluster and migrated traffic
over with no downtime that increased scalability and durability dramatically
• Led a 7-team effort across the company to rotate a secure API key
• Developed a solution for IP whitelisting in Amazon API Gateway, fronting AWS Lambdas, that later became a
recommended security practice for all teams that use Serverless technology within the company
• Strived for high system availability and stability with a 99.95% uptime and 120ms average response time while serving live traffic for both the website and the mobile apps (iOS and Android)
• Oversaw the data migration of 18M customer records from a SQL Server database to DynamoDB
• Presented about our OAuth + PKCE extension that we implemented for nordstrom.com https://bluejeans.com/s/8RyFg

positions.title: Secure API Engineer III
positions.description:
• Played a key role in migrating an on-prem datacenter to the cloud by implementing CI/CD with a tight dead line
• Developed a custom, multi-step authentication API using PKCE, while keeping the user experience simple that drives
down the malicious traffic from the website and the mobile APIs for authentication, without impacting customer
experience and revenue
• Implemented Multi-Factor Authentication via email and text, that resulted in better security for customers without
impacting conversion and revenue; recognized for engineering excellence

positions.title: Customer Mobile API Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained public and secure APIs for the mobile app while following a CI/CD model
• Developed an autoscaling policy with AWS EC2 to better scale services based on traffic
• Rewrote a .NET authentication service in Go with OAuth 2.0 – implemented a Microsoft specific protocol, WCF Binary
SOAP, in Go and open-sourced the library: github.com/khoad/msbingo
• Migrated mobile traffic from Mashery to Apigee using percentage-based routing via Akamai Phased Release

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: • Used ionicframework.com, HTML5/CSS3, AngularJS, and Apache Cordova to build hybrid mobile apps for Real Estate.

positions.title: Web Developer, UX Performance
positions.description:
• Identified and fixed potential web performance bottlenecks
• Developed applications using C# to analyze web resources performance
• Used statistics to analyze data and draw actionable conclusions to improve user experience

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Used Java, Ruby, JRuby, Node.js and AWS (EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, CFT) to develop and deploy ICA Insight, a system of
microservices for processing patient data
• Used C#.NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server, JavaScript (including jQuery), MVC, WebAPI, WCF, Entity Framework/NHibernate,
SQL Server/MySQL, and MarkLogic to develop ICA version of Direct .NET Gateway Project (http://wiki.directproject.org) o Including, but not limited to:
  - Mail engine capable of sending and receiving encrypted messages using PKI * RESTful web service for integration with other ICA products
  - Distributable client library for the REST service
  - Data warehouse for gathering and measuring usage metrics
  - Web UI application for managing the application
  - Desktop applications to ease troubleshooting
  - RPM specs to deploy part of Direct on Linux

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Used C#.NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server and JavaScript (including jQuery and AJAX) to develop a Learning Management System(LMS): Onboard
• Responsible for testing and quality assurance of Onboard LMS
• Trustworthy for providing ideas and feedbacks which helps shape the outcome of Onboard LMS

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:

• Answered students’ questions and concerns in a timely manner
• Served as an interim laboratory instructor in the professor’s absence

projects.title: ICA Direct
projects.description:
When healthcare organizations, providers, and patients exchange information today, they're likely sending paper through the mail or fax. The Direct Project aims to improve this process, making it

- Faster
- Less expensive
- More secure

How? The Direct Project establishes standards and documentation to support simple scenarios of pushing data from where it is to where it's needed, in a way that will support more sophisticated interoperability in the future.
